title: The Flooded Vale
tagline: Somerset, a wet March. The river has taken the road.
intro: Netherby Hall. The river burst its banks and flooded the drive, and nobody can get in or out. At 11:10 pm Cornelius Ware, the master of the house, is found dead in the library. One of the four people left here did it.
public_facts: The river burst its banks and flooded the drive at about 8:30 pm. Nobody could come or go after that.
The family dinner ended at about 10:00 pm.
Cornelius Ware, 70, the master of the house, went to the library at about 10:15 pm.
Cornelius Ware was found dead in the library at 11:10 pm by Marian Ware. He had been struck on the head.
The people here that night were: Marian Ware (Cornelius's sister), Hugh Padgett (estate steward), Julian Frost (a visitor), Ned Oakes (groom).

solution.motive: Hugh Padgett had been collecting higher rents than I entered in the rent book. Cornelius spoke to a tenant and learned what the rent really was and was going to call the police in the morning.
solution.method: At about 10:35 pm Hugh Padgett went to the library and argued with Cornelius, then struck him with a marble bookend. He took the true rent book to the laundry and burned it under the laundry copper.

motives.text: Revenge for something Cornelius did that day
To get control of Netherby Hall
To stop Cornelius exposing something they had done

evidence.name: Estate office rent roll
evidence.description: Hugh Padgett's rent roll from the estate office. The last entry is timed 10:10 pm. The job is not finished.

evidence.name: Butler's key book
evidence.description: A key book showing the morning room desk key signed out to the lady of the house. It puts Marian Ware in the morning room from 10:30 pm to 10:52 pm.

evidence.name: Burned rent book
evidence.description: What is left of the true rent book, found in the laundry. Parts of it can still be read.

evidence.name: Hugh's tweed jacket
evidence.description: Hugh Padgett's tweed jacket, left in the cloakroom. There is wood ash on it.

evidence.name: Eviction notice
evidence.description: A notice ordering the groom out of his cottage by the end of the month. It is dated today and names Ned Oakes.

evidence.name: Water company survey
evidence.description: A survey from a water company marking the whole valley to be flooded. It names Julian Frost.

marian_ware.name: Marian Ware
marian_ware.role: Cornelius Ware's sister. She has kept house for her brother since his wife died.
story_they_tell: After the family dinner I was in my bedroom saying my prayers.
Later I went to look for Cornelius. I found Cornelius dead in the library at 11:10 pm and I screamed.
Hugh Padgett was the first to reach me, within a minute.
Everything was perfectly fine between me and Cornelius.
shares_freely: Cornelius had been shut in the library every evening this week, in a foul mood.
This afternoon I heard Cornelius shouting at Ned Oakes. I do not know what it was about.
marian_ware.under_pressure: Go cold and formal. Repeat your account. Say you cannot believe anyone here would do this.

stages.label: Shaken
admits: I was not in my bedroom saying my prayers. From 10:30 pm to about 10:52 pm I was in the morning room, reading a copy of my brother's new will.
I was afraid he had cut me out of it. I lied because it makes me look guilty.
At 11:10 pm I went to the library and found Cornelius dead.
When Hugh Padgett reached me, he was not wearing his tweed jacket, which is unusual.

hidden_truth.secret: Was in the morning room, reading a copy of my brother's new will. I was afraid he had cut me out of it.
what_really_happened: 10:30 pm to 10:52 pm: in the morning room, reading a copy of my brother's new will.
giveaway_phrases: reading a copy of my brother's new will
I was afraid he had cut me out of it

hugh_padgett.name: Hugh Padgett
hugh_padgett.role: Estate steward. He collects the farm rents and keeps the estate accounts.
story_they_tell: After the family dinner I went to the estate office. I was writing up the quarter's rents.
I was in the estate office from about 10:00 pm until about 11:00 pm. I was alone and saw nobody.
I came when I heard the scream at 11:10 pm, and found Marian Ware at the door of the library.
I did not go near the library tonight until the scream.
I got on well with Cornelius. Nothing was wrong between us.
shares_freely: Cornelius told me this afternoon that he had evicted Ned Oakes, who took it badly.
Julian Frost has asked a lot of questions about this place.
hugh_padgett.under_pressure: Stay calm and polite. Repeat your account. Suggest, as if reluctantly, that the detective should look at Ned Oakes.

stages.label: Guarded
admits: The job was not finished. I stopped at about 10:10 pm and spent the rest of the time sorting old leases.
I still say I never left the estate office.

stages.label: Rattled
admits: I was not in the estate office the whole time. At about 10:40 pm I went to the laundry, only to see whether the flood had reached the laundry floor, and I got wood ash on my tweed jacket there.
I did not mention it before because it did not seem important.
I know nothing about any true rent book, and I still say I never went to the library.

stages.label: Broken
admits: I have been collecting higher rents than I entered in the rent book for two years.
Cornelius spoke to a tenant and learned what the rent really was this afternoon and was going to call the police in the morning.
At about 10:35 pm I went to the library to beg for more time. We argued, and at about 10:40 pm I struck Cornelius with a marble bookend.
Then I took the true rent book to the laundry and burned it under the laundry copper. That is how I got wood ash on my tweed jacket.

hidden_truth.secret: Killed Cornelius Ware. Had been collecting higher rents than I entered in the rent book.
what_really_happened: 10:35 pm: went to the library and argued with Cornelius.
10:40 pm: struck Cornelius with a marble bookend.
10:42 pm: took the true rent book to the laundry and burned it under the laundry copper.
10:50 pm: left the laundry and was seen by Ned Oakes.
giveaway_phrases: collecting higher rents than I entered in the rent book
burned it under the laundry copper

julian_frost.name: Julian Frost
julian_frost.role: A visitor. Says they are a landscape painter. He arrived a few days ago.
julian_frost.personality: Dreamy on the surface, attentive underneath.
story_they_tell: I am a landscape painter. I am here to paint the vale in spring.
After the family dinner I stayed with the others until about 10:35 pm, then I went to my own quarters.
I was in my quarters when I heard the scream at 11:10 pm, and I came out.
shares_freely: At about 10:35 pm, on my way to my quarters, I passed the library and heard two people arguing inside. One was Cornelius, and he was the loud one. The other voice was low and controlled. I could not tell who it was.
I heard Cornelius say something like 'two years' and 'in the morning'.
Cornelius and Marian Ware did not seem to get on.
julian_frost.under_pressure: Stay charming and a little amused. Repeat your account. Remark that Cornelius and Marian Ware did not seem to get on.

stages.label: Exposed
admits: I am not a landscape painter. I am an agent for a water company, and I want to buy the valley for a reservoir.
Two days ago I told Cornelius what I wanted, and he refused angrily and told me to leave. I stayed on anyway.
From what I have seen this week, something is badly wrong with how this place is run, and I think Cornelius had just found out.

hidden_truth.secret: Is really an agent for a water company and wants to buy the valley for a reservoir.
what_really_happened: 10:35 pm: passed the library and heard the argument, then went to their quarters.
giveaway_phrases: an agent for a water company
buy the valley for a reservoir

ned_oakes.name: Ned Oakes
ned_oakes.role: Groom. He looks after the horses and the carriage.
story_they_tell: After the family dinner I was in the stables, bedding down the horses. I stayed there until I heard the scream at 11:10 pm.
I saw nobody after about 10:00 pm.
Things between me and Cornelius were fine, same as always.
shares_freely: Julian Frost has been asking the people here odd questions.
Cornelius had been in a bad temper all week.
ned_oakes.under_pressure: Get irritated and defensive. Repeat your account. Say the detective should look at Julian Frost, who has been asking a lot of questions.

stages.label: Cornered
admits: Cornelius evicted me this afternoon. I hid it because it makes me look guilty.
I was not in the stables the whole time. From about 10:40 pm to 10:55 pm I was at the back of the stables, moving feed sacks above the water.
At about 10:50 pm I saw Hugh Padgett coming out of the laundry, with wood ash on his tweed jacket. He did not see me.
The laundry is nowhere near the estate office.

hidden_truth.secret: Cornelius evicted them today, and they were at the back of the stables at the time of the murder.
what_really_happened: 10:40 pm to 10:55 pm: at the back of the stables, moving feed sacks above the water.
10:50 pm: saw Hugh Padgett leave the laundry.
giveaway_phrases: at the back of the stables
moving feed sacks above the water
